text.p: ProNet Inc said on Wednesday its fourth-quarter operating cash flow, or earnings before other income, income taxes, depreciation and amortization and nonrecurring charges -- EBITDA -- increased 29 percent to $7.1 million compared with $5.5 million for the fourth quarter of 1995.

"The generation of free cash flow is one of our major focal points, and we plan to continue with our disciplined growth strategy to continue to achieve this," said Jackie Kimzey, chairman and chief executive.
The company also said it added a net 128,384 paging units during the fourth quarter. ProNet had 1,270,954 pagers in service at the end of the year, a 48 percent increase over last year.

The EBITDA margin for the fourth quarter was 29 percent compared with 31 percent for the same quarter of 1995. Net revenues for the fourth quarter increased 41 percent to $24.8 million compared with $17.6 million for the same quarter last year.
